## Hello! 👋

I am a Data Scientist and **applied researcher** with a **Ph.D. in Geospatial Analytics**. Over the past eight years, I have built predictive models to make sense of everything from telecommunication operations to ecological system responses. 

My passion lies in taking complex spatial-temporal data and turning it into clear, actionable insights. I enjoy blending foundational statistical methods, like **Bayesian inference** and **geostatistics**, with **modern AI tools** to build intelligent systems and novel frameworks that help answer tough questions. 

Right now, my interests are lie at the intersection of **Agentic Workflows** and **Complex Spatial Networks**. I am leveraging my background in computational statistics to explore how we can design AI systems capable of reasoning through and optimizing spatial data autonomously.

### Core Competencies
* **Modelling & Statistics:** Geostatistics, Bayesian Inference, Uplift Modeling, Survival Analysis, XGBoost, Generalized Additive Models (GAMs), Monte Carlo Simulation.
* **Programming & Data:** Python, R, SQL, SAS, Matlab, Amazon Redshift, PostgreSQL.
* **BI & Geospatial:** Tableau, Power BI, ArcGIS/QGIS, Alteryx.
* **AI Integration:** Prompt Engineering, GenAI integrations, Agentic Workflows (In Progress).


*This website is a portfolio of my experiments with agentic workflows and anything I find interesting in general.*
